name: Consensus Voting & Arbitration Aggregator
description: Implement resolveConsensus<T> in src/consensus.ts to compute majority decision across 3 agent outputs.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement resolveConsensus<T>(outputs: T[]): T in src/consensus.ts: 1) If 2 or more outputs match, return the majority output. 2) If all 3 disagree, return the first output as default fallback. Ensure test/consensus.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: Handles 3-way tie by falling back to outputs[0]
